news.title: UW–Madison designates 2026 as the ‘Year of AI Readiness and Competency’
news.summary_en: The effort, which supports a number of campus priorities, will focus on a people-centered approach to guide thoughtful use of artificial intelligence on campus.

news.title: $85.2 million gift from John and Tashia Morgridge will support Science Hall transformation
news.summary_en: The historic building will undergo renovation starting in 2027 to restore its iconic exterior, create new gathering space and modernize its interior to support learning and research.

news.title: UW–Madison student awarded prestigious Udall Scholarship
news.summary_en: The national honor recognizes undergraduate Aryana Wadhwani as a future leader in the environmental field.

news.title: Getting to work in service to an extraordinary university
news.summary_en: In a first-day message to UW–Madison faculty and staff, interim Chancellor Eric Wilcots looks to move the university forward, together.
